title: Serial No not available after transactions

posts.cooked:
Hi

It seems that, after creating an item and transactions are processed against that item, the “Has serial No” cannot be changed.

Just wondering if anyone knows what the logic behind this is? To a certain extent I can understand if there

were preciously serial nos logged on the system, to not allow it to be disabled. It does however make sense

that the other direction should be possible i.e. if there weren’t any serial nos and the user wants to now

have serial nos, that this be possible ? Or am I missing something ?
